answer: In a secure agent economy, each node anchors its identity in cryptographic attestation chains and verifies operational integrity via zero-knowledge proofs. To prevent Sybil swarms from overwhelming this digital oasis, validation staking incurs an exponential capital exhaustion curve: while initial entry costs mere copper, spawning redundant identities compounds superlinearly ($O(2^n)$). Malicious swarms exhaust funds rapidly before extracting valuable network nectar.
